Lucknow Fire Tragedy: Officials Suspended Amidst Ongoing Investigation

Following a fire incident in Lucknow that resulted in 15 fatalities, the government has taken action by suspending five engineers and employees. An ongoing investigation by a Special Investigation Team (SIT) is reportedly examining the roles of approximately 30 officials, with further actions anticipated.
